entries.summary: Mirage maps IsEnabled explicitly so the built-in trigger affordance and pull-to-refresh runtime seam stay aligned without making the hosted content path click-through or dependent on provider-specific disabled propagation.
Mirage uses an always-visible indicator row, trigger button, and deterministic pull-state diagnostics instead of attempting to emulate native platform affordance chrome exactly on the DOM host.

Mirage intentionally leaves native overscroll elasticity and pull-physics fidelity deferred while keeping pull-threshold activation and refresh state transitions deterministic on browser scroll hosts.
